headline: Deere & Company reports Q4 earnings miss and cautious 2027 outlook
summary: Deere & Company reported fourth-quarter net income of $1.051 billion, missing earnings estimates by $0.14 per share. The company provided a fiscal 2027 outlook that fell below analyst expectations, citing evolving conditions in key agricultural markets.
why: Deere & Company is a global leader in agricultural and construction machinery. Its results and guidance are key indicators for the health of the global farming sector and industrial capital expenditure.

impacts.name: Deere & Company
impacts.why: The company missed earnings estimates and provided weak forward guidance.
